context.blocks:
- while {condition: boolean}: A loop that repeatedly executes the blocks inside as long as the condition is true.
- if {condition: boolean}: Executes the blocks inside only once, and only if the provided boolean expression evaluates to true.
- else: Executes the blocks inside only if the if block above it, and any elif blocks in the same chain, did not run. Must be placed directly below an if or an elif.
- not {value: boolean}: Flips a true or false value to the opposite one. Put a condition inside it to ask whether that condition is NOT true.
- step forward: Steps the robot one tile forward, in the direction it is facing. Fails if the robot hits a wall.
- turn {direction: string}: Rotates the robot 90 degrees to the left or right, or turns it around to face the other way.
- ahead is {what: blocked/destination/puddle}: Asks what is on the single tile directly in front of the robot. True only if that tile holds the thing you picked.
